items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Edgar Hayes was the first musician - you know Edgar Hayes; he's my girl friend's husband. They live out in California. We all came up together.

ctx.x: Joe Garland wrote it; Edgar Hayes played it. Edgar Hayes was the first musician - you know Edgar Hayes; he's my girl friend's husband. They live out in California. We all came up together. Edgar Hayes wanted to buy that music. When I lived down on ( ) Seventh Avenue he lived down there too, he and his wife. They all wanted to buy this music. He wouldn't sell it to nobody but Glenn Miller, Joe Garland.
He didn't sell it to Glenn Miller. Joe Garland is rich off of that tune today.
